title: Reading $dump or $page_list inside an explicit transaction makes its next safepoint fail an ENSURE and stop the engine

package.logContains: REPRODUCED: after $dump or $page_list read pages that an explicit transaction had safepointed into the WAL, its next safepoint failed an ENSURE (LiteException 999: only idle readable pages can be evicted), which stopped the engine and marked the data file invalid

latest.logContains: FIXED: after $dump or $page_list read pages that an explicit transaction had safepointed into the WAL, its safepoints and its commit succeeded, and a reopen found every row of it (1001 documents, 1000 updated)
